# Copilot Instructions for Max

## Tool Naming

**Do NOT create tools that share a name with built-in Copilot CLI tools.** Copilot CLI reserves certain tool names (e.g. `task`, `bash`, `grep`, `glob`, `view`, `edit`, `create`, etc.). If Max defines a tool with the same name, it will conflict at runtime.

When naming custom tools, use unique prefixes or alternative verbs to avoid collisions.
